_comment: YouTube Innertube client fingerprints. When extraction breaks, update these from yt-dlp's yt_dlp/extractor/youtube/_base.py. 'clients' are tried in order until one returns playabilityStatus == OK. JS-less clients (no signature cipher / n-transform) are strongly preferred so we never need a JS engine.
_verified: 2026-08-22 — visionos confirmed returning full H264 ladder (144p-1080p60) with direct uncphered URLs
_search_note: search/browse return metadata (no stream URLs), so the WEB client works cleanly with no bot wall and gives the richest result layout.
